Class MiniMap

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas
org.ether.society.ui.MiniMap
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class MiniMap extends javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas
Mini-map component showing overview of entire simulation area. Displays current viewport and allows click-to-navigate.
